Also, we need the credit to show EU VAT correctly on the credit note. Our VAT ID is GB123456789 and we will be reclaiming per local rules. Can you provide:

Hi Amelia — thanks for flagging this and including the PO.

Short answer: you should see a proration. I'm sorry for the confusion — looks like the original invoice generation picked up the pre-change allocation. I've run a provisional calc and attached the spreadsheet. Summary here:

- Original reserved pool: 10 GPUs for Jan (monthly list price: $12,000/month)
- Effective reduction: 2026-01-04 (so 3 days at 10 GPUs, 28 days at 6 GPUs)
- Pro rata charge (days basis, Jan has 31 days):
  - Days 1–3: full-month rate pro-rated for 10 GPUs = (10/10) * 3/31 * $12,000 = $1,161.29
  - Days 4–31: reduced rate for 6 GPUs = (6/10) * 28/31 * $12,000 = $6,487.10
  - Total pro-rated service charge: $7,648.39
  - Original full-month charge: $12,000.00
  - Net credit due to you (pre-VAT): $4,351.61

VAT handling: since you provided a UK VAT ID (GB123456789) and you're in the EU region, we'll show VAT at 20% on the invoice lines per local tax rules unless you confirm reverse-charge applies for your setup. For credit notes we include the VAT line so your finance team can match it.

Next steps for us:
- I can have Finance generate an official credit note and a revised invoice that includes the PO and the VAT breakout.
- Please confirm whether you want the credit automatically applied to the next Redwood invoice (recommended) or if you require a bank refund.

Attaching provisional_proration_calc.xlsx for your review.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai
